title: sorted CD4+ T cells from healthy donor, HD3
extract_protocol_ch1: Sorted live CD4+ T cells were resuspended in PBS supplemented with 0.2% non-acetylated BSA (Miltenyi) and viability was determined using trypan blue staining and measured on Countess FLII (Thermo-Fisher).

50,000 cells were loaded for capture on 10x Chromium system using the V3 single cell reagent kit for 3 prime RNA sequencing (10x Thechnologies). After capture and lysis, cDNAs from the cells were amplified as per 10x Chromium’s recommendations (10x Thechnologies. The amplified cDNAs were loaded on a single lane of NovaSeq 6000 for a depth of 50,000 reads per cell.
data_processing: Single cell demultiplxing and gene counting were performed using 10X Cell Ranger.
Assembly: GRCh38
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separated values (barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz)
